loci.label: I 5′
loci.note: Contig and outward raw/primary GFA route agree on the core-facing sequence. C000025 supplies the terminal tract.
loci.orientation: Distance inward from the current assembled tip

loci.label: I 3′
loci.note: Primary unitig continuation and C000043 cap. The raw graph starts along the same extension. A longer primary-contig path and C000028 supply an alternative branch.
loci.orientation: Distance inward from the current assembled tip

loci.label: II 5′
loci.note: Latest review includes II_unloc_3, reversed II_unloc_1, and 7,933 bp from agreeing primary and raw unitigs. The new distal tip is open.
loci.orientation: Distance inward from the current assembled tip

loci.label: II 3′
loci.note: Exact original junction and single continuous HiFi molecule from C000037. The cap sits distal to the major S2G site.
loci.orientation: Distance inward from the current assembled tip

loci.label: III 5′
loci.note: Identical 14,134 bp continuation in raw and primary unitigs and primary contig. A HiFi molecule crosses the old tip into most of the extension.
loci.orientation: Distance inward from the current assembled tip

loci.label: III 3′
loci.note: Exact original junction and single continuous HiFi molecule from C000047.
loci.orientation: Distance inward from the current assembled tip

loci.label: IV 5′
loci.note: One original molecule from C000042 spans the alternate terminal satellite and outward telomere at a unique exact anchor.
loci.orientation: Distance inward from the current assembled tip

loci.label: IV 3′
loci.note: Distal C000019 molecule covers the rDNA terminal join. Other C000019 reads support an inner S2G site and the array has alternative lengths.
loci.orientation: Distance inward from the current assembled tip

loci.label: V 5′
loci.note: The primary unitig reassigns part of I_unloc_1 to V. HiFi molecules support the frozen seam and the transition into the unlocalized sequence. A named GFA A-record molecule provides the outward cap.
loci.orientation: Distance inward from the current assembled tip

loci.label: V 3′
loci.note: A continuous HiFi molecule extends the old tip into the repeat. Further proposals through the repeat and V_unloc_2 lack a continuous uniquely placed link and the distal cap remains unresolved.
loci.orientation: Distance inward from the current assembled tip

loci.label: X 5′
loci.note: The raw and primary graphs replace the terminal 9 bp with an 805 bp continuation. The underlying read and C000001 show competing repeat placements, so the germline telomere remains open.
loci.orientation: Distance inward from the current assembled tip

loci.label: X 3′
loci.note: A single HiFi molecule exactly spans the 4,235 bp primary and raw graph continuation. The repeat-rich 80 kb primary-contig path stays unplaced.
loci.orientation: Distance inward from the current assembled tip

loci.label: I_unloc_1
loci.note: Feeds the GFA and read-supported V 5′ extension.
loci.orientation: Native fragment coordinate from its 5′ end

loci.label: II_unloc_1
loci.note: Reverse orientation in the latest II extension. Its native 3′ edge faces outward.
loci.orientation: Native fragment coordinate from its 5′ end

loci.label: II_unloc_2
loci.note: Proposed farther II 5′ route. The distal read overhang matches several copies in this repeat.
loci.orientation: Native fragment coordinate from its 5′ end

loci.label: II_unloc_3
loci.note: Forward orientation. Four ONT molecules bridge its native 3′ edge to the former II 5′ tip.
loci.orientation: Native fragment coordinate from its 5′ end

loci.label: II_unloc_4
loci.note: Matches part of the 7,933 bp continuation at II 5′. Longer placement remains ambiguous.
loci.orientation: Native fragment coordinate from its 5′ end

loci.label: III_unloc_1
loci.note: The accepted I 3′ path uses part of this sequence. The contig label is from the frozen assembly.
loci.orientation: Native fragment coordinate from its 5′ end

loci.label: V_unloc_1
loci.note: Contained in the C000038 capped fragment. III 5′ and V 3′ remain competing placements.
loci.orientation: Native fragment coordinate from its 5′ end

loci.label: V_unloc_2
loci.note: The longer V 3′ primary contig runs through this fragment. Repeat homology continues toward the V_unloc_1 cap candidate.
loci.orientation: Native fragment coordinate from its 5′ end

loci.label: C000038 cap fragment
loci.note: Primary unitig utg000068l and primary contig ptg000020l describe the same 202,511 bp path. Full HiFi reads support the telomere junction. Its opposite edge matches the III 5′ and V 3′ repeat.
loci.orientation: From the candidate outward edge inward

loci.label: Long V 3′ path
loci.note: Distal 165,508 bp of the longer V 3′ primary contig, shown from its candidate tip inward. It includes V_unloc_2. Raw utg000162l reproduces the last 33 kb in the corresponding orientation.
loci.orientation: From the candidate outward edge inward

loci.label: Farther II path
loci.note: Primary unitig utg000063l contains reversed II_unloc_4 and part of II_unloc_2. Native 5′ position is the proposed farther outward side. The join to the latest II tip remains unresolved.
loci.orientation: From the candidate outward edge inward

loci.label: Long I 3′ allele
loci.note: Last 85 kb of primary contig ptg000013l, shown from its candidate distal tip inward. A longer alternative supported by C000028. The reviewed I 3′ end uses C000043.
loci.orientation: From the candidate outward edge inward

repeats.label: 175–343 bp mixed
repeats.note: A broad satellite group with distinct short units, 343 bp arrays and longer combinations. X 5′ is dominated by a 343 bp variant. X 3′ and the extended II 5′ tip have mixed architectures.

repeats.label: 20 bp array
repeats.note: The outer III 5′ repeat. Longer candidate paths on III and V share its markers. Placement depends on the adjoining unique flanks and the orientation of the repeat.

repeats.label: 23 bp array
repeats.note: The former II 5′ port. A matching array at the 3′ edge of II_unloc_3 is bridged by four ONT reads. The repeat is now internal to the extended II 5′ arm.

repeats.label: ~95 bp array
repeats.note: Two overlapping family labels describe a related repeat with 32 bp periodicity in parts of the II arrays.

repeats.label: 82 / 177 bp arrays
repeats.note: Overlapping family labels for a mixed satellite. A large block lies inward of III 5′, with related sequence on the V route and II 3′.

repeats.label: 69 bp arrays
repeats.note: Related 69 bp annotations sat_fam11 and sat_fam12.

edges.label: Reads enter unlocalized sequence

edges.label: Reads enter unlocalized sequence

edges.label: Alternate longer cap route

edges.label: Capped fragment contains V_unloc_1
edges.note: A nearly exact 133 kb graph placement. Molecules support the cap junction on the fragment. Position on a specific chromosome is still ambiguous.

edges.label: Compatible 20 bp repeat
edges.note: Correct inward orientation at the capped fragment. The repeat-facing V route shares more distinct oriented 21-mers (352 versus 269). Direct bridge to III 5′ absent in the targeted screen.

edges.label: Primary contig continuation
edges.note: The review includes the first read-spanned extension. The longer primary contig continues through additional repeats and V_unloc_2.

edges.label: Graph and partial read evidence
edges.note: A full V_unloc_2 alignment and an approximately 33 kb tail reproduced by raw utg000162l. Tested ONT pairings have competing repeat placements.

edges.label: Compatible 20 bp repeat
edges.note: Compatible direction. The V graph path is the main competitor for the C000038 fragment.

edges.label: Conflicting ONT read placement
edges.note: One ONT molecule with an X 5′ repeat placement also has a 7.4 kb cap-adjacent alignment near the accepted I 5′ cap. Whole-read placements compete. This edge records ambiguity.
